_readme: STUB -- a three-camera corridor on Mahatma Gandhi Road, enough to prove the port
works. Not a surveyed deployment: extend it before using it for anything real.
These positions were produced by the procedure in README.md, section 'Porting to a
new city': arterial ways pulled from OSM, anchors taken ~1.2 km apart along the
road, then each camera moved ~110 m back along its approach and ~9 m onto the
left-hand carriageway. All three snap to the road network within 10 m, which is
what makes the graphgen heading filter see a real departure bearing.
Do NOT place cameras on intersection centroids. The README explains what that
costs: roughly 18 edges and 8 isolated cameras, which is what our first attempt
To use: CAMERA_SET=agra, restart, then run the graphgen profile.
